test.title: CheckFactsTest
test.checks: identical text clean; swapped amounts between names; a number next to the same word as in the original is not a swap (final4 q03 card was flagged against itself; the fix removed all 40 such alarms over 882 final2-4 outputs, all checked false, no other report changed); lost/added numbers; units and number words normalised; HH:00 equals hour; unit change; inverted negation; moved negation not flagged; lost name; name in another case kept; assistant utm tail is not a lost link, a lost author utm tag is; lost link; dates incl. ranges; hedge loss is a check; modality/scope/condition/attribution words that got rarer and intensifiers that got more frequent are checks; polite Вы/Ваш is not a name; a date does not span a line break; lost structural HTML tags are errors, lost emphasis tags are checks, autolinks are not tags; quotes (issue #264): changed direct speech or a quote after a colon is an error, quote marks and case endings may change, rephrased quoted words inside a phrase, words left without their marks and new quotes are checks, inch marks are not quotes (over 1446 old eval outputs the 302 of humanizer-ru gained 2 errors: a thought in quotes lost its first words, a cut example from chat advice); CLI exit codes 0/1/2 incl. the issue case; 4.1.4 (property run over 1028 eval texts plus bug hunts by GPT-6.1 Sol and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, every finding rerun by hand): versions 2.1.3, weekdays (not «рабочая среда»), inline code, phones by digits, link host case and trailing slash, IPv6 link without a crash, 12-digit number precision, scale «тыс.» before its unit, units after word numbers, decimal with a unit is not a time, «2020 г.» is a year, 16:00 = 16 часов, «с 5 по 7 марта», «двадцать один», «одну» = 1, a lost unit is a check, month without a day, «не на карту», «нельзя» → «можно», an added negation and a lost contrast negation are checks, «никаких» negates, full names bind numbers, short names in another case, Cyrillic acronyms, direct speech word for word, gender in the report (rerun over 1446 old outputs: 3 of 302 humanizer-ru reports turned into errors, all checked as real losses)

gaps.gap: report.py, the free DSH route and the subagent batches have unit tests; the scripts that call paid APIs are checked by hand on dev runs, and the probe exclusion from coverage by the final4 summary.

check_facts.py compares quotes of up to 80 characters in «», „“, “” and straight marks; single quotes and longer quotes are not compared. It cannot tell a quotation from a term or an example inside a phrase, so only direct speech and quotes after a colon are errors; a lost quotation inside a phrase is only a check.

check_facts.py cannot tell a name from another name with the same stem (Мария/Марина, Марии/Марине) or a fleeting vowel beyond stem matching (Лев/Льва); a number rewritten as a word for a unit («24 часа» → «сутки») is reported as lost on purpose (numbers are carried as is); prose wrapped in ``` and a code block of mostly Cyrillic text are not compared as code.
check_facts.py does not see lost conditions in words ("при включённой двухфакторной аутентификации"); the skill tells the agent to reread conditions.

The comparison emulates a skill run through the API with a read_file tool; installed runs in Claude Code and DSH are checked by hand on a few texts. final4 ran the executor as Claude Code subagents in batches (README), so its numbers compare participants with each other, not with earlier runs.
